title: Bayesian Tensor Train Kernel Machines with Automatic Model Complexity Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.07129v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tensor Network (TN) kernel machines accelerate supervised learning by using low-rank TNs to reduce computation and memory. However, most TN-based methods are deterministic with manually tuned ranks and feature dimensions, while the existing Bayesian TN kernel machine is restricted to the CANDECOMP/PARAFAC decomposition (CPD), whose single rank is shared by all modes. We extend this framework to the tensor train (TT) and propose Bayesian Tensor Train Kernel Machines (BTT-KM), whose hierarchical ARD-type priors on the TT cores infer the TT ranks and feature dimensions from data. Since each TT core is coupled to the others only through its neighbors, its closed-form posterior update requires propagating the contributions of all other cores along the chain. translated_title: 具有自动模型复杂度推断的贝叶斯张量链核机器
translated_abstract: 张量网络（TN）核机器通过使用低秩张量网络来降低计算量和内存需求，从而加速监督学习。然而，大多数基于张量网络的方法是确定性的，其秩和特征维度需要手动调整，而现有的贝叶斯张量网络核机器仅限于CANDECOMP/PARAFAC分解（CPD），其单一秩由所有模式共享。我们将该框架扩展到张量链（TT）分解，提出了贝叶斯张量链核机器（BTT-KM），其在TT核心上的分层ARD类型先验可以从数据中自动推断TT秩和特征维度。由于每个TT核心仅通过其相邻核心与链上其他核心耦合，其闭式后验更新需要沿链传播所有其他核心的贡献。平均场变分推断产生了一个贝叶斯交替最小二乘算法，其计算复杂度与确定性对应算法相同，并具有闭式预测分布。
tldr: 本文提出了贝叶斯张量链核机器（BTT-KM），通过在TT核心上施加分层ARD先验并结合平均场变分推断，实现了从数据中自动推断TT秩与特征维度的闭式贝叶斯学习，且计算复杂度与确定性方法相同。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Bayesian Tensor Train Kernel Machines (BTT-KM), which leverage hierarchical ARD-type priors on TT cores and mean-field variational inference to automatically infer TT ranks and feature dimensions from data, achieving closed-form Bayesian learning with the same computational complexity as its deterministic counterpart.
